name: crapkit
description: crapkit's agent tools: three skills, the MCP server for score inspection and gate checks, and one advisory PostToolUse hook that names functions an edit pushed over their ceiling. The hook and the MCP server both spawn the bare `crapkit` console script, so it has to be on PATH, and it has to be the same crapkit release as the plugin, since the skills run that release's commands and flags. `crapkit doctor --plugin-root` compares an installed copy against the CLI it will call and reports any version gap. The commit gate stays the only enforcement point; this hook never blocks.
